title: Official headers, weather, outputs, and boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Define official report numbering, weather sources, required Excel/PDF deliverables, unknown-data behavior, fingerprint scope, and cross-phase ownership.
defects: DEF-B01-06-GAP-01: Backend schema and exporters lack official report numbering (<projectID>-<projectDay>-<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>) and actual project day calculation from project start date (FR-017, H05, C08, DEF-B01-01)
DEF-B01-06-GAP-02: Free MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 client and 3-day project location forecast integration are missing in apps/api/core/field_reports/ (FR-017, X07, C08, DEF-B01-05)
DEF-B01-06-GAP-03: Observed wind and ground conditions from weather logs are omitted from official daily report header exports (FR-017, X07, C08)
DEF-B01-06-GAP-04: Multi-sheet date-range Excel workbook exporter is not implemented in field_reports or report_export_service (FR-016, E17, C05)
DEF-B01-06-GAP-05: Standalone discipline sub-report PDF exporter is not implemented in apps/api/core/sub_reports/ (FR-016, C07)

verificationDetails.specStatus: Ratified in specs/057-a1-b01-data-contract/spec.md under C05, C06, C07, C08, US6, FR-016, FR-017, FR-018, FR-019
verificationDetails.officialReportNumber: Absent in field_reports/models.py, shiraz_file4_excel.py, and pdf.py
verificationDetails.weatherIntegration: Basic weather fields exist, but MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 integration and wind/ground log integration are absent
verificationDetails.deliverablesParity: Single-day Excel and PDF exist; discipline Excel exists; multi-sheet date-range Excel workbook and standalone discipline PDFs are absent
verificationDetails.securityScope: C06 verified: strictly actor attribution + metadata fingerprint; PKI certificate signatures properly excluded
verificationDetails.boundaries: FR-019 and 18-section disposition matrix cleanly preserve X01-X06, X08-X10 to external owner phases

summary: Requirement B01-06 failed QA verification against the codebase: while C05-C08 and boundary rules are ratified in the specification, the software implementation lacks official report numbering, MET Norway 3-day weather forecast integration, wind/ground weather-log headers, multi-sheet date-range Excel exports, and standalone discipline PDFs.
